scenes.title: HOW IT WORKS
scenes.narration: Deep inside every home, there is a machine that performs a small miracle, every single day. This... is how a washing machine works.

scenes.title: THE TWO DRUMS
scenes.narration: At its heart are two drums. A perforated inner drum, that cradles your laundry. And an outer tub, that catches every drop of water.

scenes.title: WATER INTAKE
scenes.narration: When the cycle begins, an inlet valve opens. Water rushes in, mixing with detergent, until the perfect level is reached.

scenes.title: THE WASH CYCLE
scenes.narration: Then, the wash begins. The drum tumbles the clothes back and forth, again and again, letting detergent lift away dirt, fiber by fiber.

scenes.title: DRAIN AND RINSE
scenes.narration: Next, the pump evacuates the dirty water, and fresh water rinses the load clean.

scenes.title: THE SPIN CYCLE
scenes.narration: Then comes the spin. The drum accelerates to over one thousand revolutions per minute, and centrifugal force flings the water out, through thousands of tiny holes.

scenes.title: PERFECTLY CLEAN
scenes.narration: From soiled, to spotless, in under an hour. That is the hidden engineering, of clean laundry.
